description: Temu affiliate and catalog scope for overseas collection. Official publisher product API is unverified as of 2026-10-14; Partner Platform OpenAPI is seller/ISV scoped. Prefer affiliate dashboard links. See references/overseas-official-api-first.md and checklists note in legal-tos-overseas.md. 2026-10-15: storefront HTTP expansion is applicable; see references/overseas-retail-frontier.json. Affiliate approval remains independent.

capabilities.title: Issue or read affiliate referral/product links from the Temu affiliate dashboard tools
capabilities.blocker: No HTTP contract observed for dashboard link issuance. Manual/dashboard-only until a first-party API receipt exists. FAQ: https://www.temu.com/affiliate_question.html

capabilities.title: Search affiliate-eligible products with price and currency via an official publisher API
capabilities.blocker: No verified Temu affiliate product search API for publishers. partner.temu.com OpenAPI targets sellers/ERP (openapi-b-*.temu.com), not confirmed for affiliate catalog reads.

capabilities.title: Anonymous temu storefront catalog through observed HTTP Documents, Fetch or XHR
capabilities.blocker: Browser home displayed products, but the observed best-sellers Document replay returned HTTP 200 with no verified product catalog. CDP network capture is blocked_runtime; HTTP 200 is not catalog success.

capabilities.title: Record ship-to country and response currency on each offer
capabilities.blocker: Depends on an official catalog channel; axes defined in references/geo-locale-currency.md.

capabilities.title: Customer account login
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Affiliate collection does not use end-customer login.
